title: Video-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement of Video Understanding Agents via Harness Evolution
title_zh: 视频理解代理的视频递归自我改进

paragraphs.en: Video understanding agents acquire evidence through an executable harness that controls what they observe and how they use those observations. However, execution traces contain only the evidence acquired by the current harness, leaving competing explanations for failure unresolved and limiting the basis for self-improvement. We introduce Video-RSI, a framework for recursive self-improvement in which a video understanding agent uses its own language model to revise its harness. Through active video investigation, the model revisits the original training videos to test competing failure explanations with additional observations, grounding proposed changes in evidence beyond the existing trace. Cost-aware harness evolution turns these diagnoses into reusable revisions and determines which revisions to retain by considering both answer accuracy and visual cost. Across our evaluation settings on video understanding benchmarks, the evolved agent improves accuracy while processing fewer frames and achieves competitive accuracy-efficiency trade-offs against existing video understanding agents. These results demonstrate the potential for video understanding agents to improve their own evidence acquisition and use through harness evolution. Code is available at https://github.com/bingjunluo/Video-RSI .

paragraphs.en: Video understanding agents must decide what to observe before they can decide how to answer. In long videos, relevant events may be brief, temporally distant, or surrounded by visually similar distractions. Recent agents address this challenge through iterative retrieval, temporal navigation, and tool-guided observation ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . At each step, the agent must choose where to look, which details to inspect, and whether the evidence is sufficient to answer. These decisions are governed by an executable harness that controls evidence acquisition, processes observations, and supports subsequent reasoning. The harness shapes both what the model sees and how it uses that evidence, linking answer accuracy to the cost of visual observation. Improving this executable layer is therefore an opportunity to strengthen video understanding without changing model weights.

paragraphs.en: Automated agent design uses feedback to improve agent programs ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) , and recent work extends code-level evolution to video understanding ( Xu and Chen, 2026 ) . Self-Harness further shows that a frozen model can revise its own operating harness in terminal environments ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . We study this form of harness self-improvement for video understanding. The language model that answers video questions also investigates failures and revises the code governing its behavior. As shown in Figure 1 , adaptive evidence gathering changes what an agent observes within a question, while harness self-improvement changes the procedure it uses across subsequent questions. This makes execution experience a basis for revising how evidence is acquired and organized, allowing useful changes to accumulate in the program. Our objective is to turn execution experience into reusable improvements that increase answer accuracy while reducing visual observation, with the underlying models fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化智能体设计利用反馈来改进智能体程序（Hu 等人，2025；Lee 等人，2026），而近期的研究则将代码层面的演化扩展到了视频理解领域（Xu 和 Chen，2026）。 Self-Harness 进一步表明，一个已冻结的模型可以在终端环境中自行修改其运行框架（Zhang 等人，2026a）。 我们针对视频理解场景研究了这种框架自我改进的形式。 回答视频问题的语言模型还会分析失败原因，并修正控制其行为的相关代码。 如图 1 所示，自适应证据收集会改变智能体在单个问题中观察到的内容，而框架自我改进则会改变其在后续问题中所使用的流程。 这使得执行经验成为修订证据获取与组织方式的基础，从而允许程序中的有效改进逐步积累。 我们的目标是在底层模型固定的前提下，将执行经验转化为可重复使用的改进措施，以提高回答准确性，同时减少视觉观察量。

paragraphs.en: This objective requires both evidence for a revision and a criterion for deciding whether to retain it. An execution trace contains only the observations acquired by the current harness. A missing event may therefore reflect a sampling gap, a perceptual error, or a failure to use available evidence, each requiring a different modification. For instance, an event absent from the recorded observations does not establish whether the agent failed to inspect it or misinterpreted what it saw. Revisiting the video can help distinguish these explanations before the code is changed. Yet correcting a failure does not necessarily produce a better harness. Denser sampling may improve an answer while increasing visual cost across many questions, whereas better evidence reuse may avoid redundant inspection. Useful self-improvement must connect a supported failure diagnosis to an assessment of the revised harness’s accuracy and visual cost over complete executions.
paragraphs.zh: 这一目标既需要修订的证据，也需要一个判断是否保留修订结果的标准。 执行轨迹仅包含当前执行框架所获取的观察结果。 因此，缺失的事件可能反映了采样间隙、感知错误，或是未能利用可用证据，而每种情况都需要不同的修改方式。 例如，记录在观察结果中缺失的事件并不能说明智能体是未能检查该事件，还是误解了所见内容。 在修改代码之前，重新观看视频有助于区分这些可能的解释。 然而，纠正一个错误并不必然能产生更优的执行框架。 更密集的采样可能会提升答案质量，但也会增加许多问题中的视觉成本；而更有效的证据复用则可能避免重复检查。 有益的自我改进必须将有依据的故障诊断与对修订后执行框架在完整执行过程中的准确性和视觉成本的评估联系起来。

paragraphs.en: We introduce Video-RSI , a framework in which the same frozen language model serves as both Solver and Editor to recursively improve a video agent’s executable harness. Active Video Investigation revisits training videos to test failure explanations and inform code revisions. Cost-Aware Harness Evolution evaluates the resulting candidates by answer accuracy and visual cost, retaining revisions that become the starting point for further improvement. These mechanisms link evidence for what to change with criteria for which changes should accumulate. The resulting loop can revise observation strategies and evidence-processing routines together, assessing their combined effect on the behavior of the complete agent. Evolution takes place offline. The selected harness is then frozen for evaluation on new questions. Across four video understanding benchmarks, the evolved harness improves accuracy while processing fewer frames than its initial version and achieves competitive accuracy–efficiency trade-offs against existing video agents. On MLVU, active investigation also yields higher final accuracy than trace-only revision at similar inference-time frame usage.

paragraphs.en: Video agents address long videos by deciding which evidence to acquire and how to organize it for reasoning. Iterative retrieval and hierarchical representations allow VideoAgent and VideoTree to concentrate on question-relevant content ( Wang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) , while VCA guides exploration with intrinsic rewards and a bounded visual memory ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . Beyond frame selection, document retrieval ( Ma et al., 2025 ) and multi-granular tool use ( Zhang et al., 2025b ; Lin et al., 2026 ) connect video observations to successive reasoning steps. DVD combines global browsing, clip search, and direct frame inspection. VideoSeek provides complementary overview, skim, and focus operations. MR.Video uses MapReduce to reconcile entities and aggregate question-specific analyses across segments ( Pang and Wang, 2025 ) , while LVAgent combines the observations and reasoning of multiple agents through dynamic collaboration ( Chen et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: Automated agent design treats the programs surrounding language models as an optimization space. ADAS searches over agents expressed in code, while AFlow searches executable workflows ( Hu et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) . These formulations allow changes to the composition and control of model calls beyond isolated prompt edits. Meta-Harness extends this direction by using historical code, evaluation scores, and execution traces to optimize harnesses around a fixed model ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . This program-level view motivates our choice of an executable harness as the object of improvement, encompassing both evidence-processing tools and the logic that uses their outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化智能体设计将围绕语言模型的程序视为一个优化空间。 ADAS 在代码中表达的智能体之间进行搜索，而 AFlow 则搜索可执行的工作流（Hu et al., 2025；Zhang et al., 2025a）。 这些公式化方法允许对模型调用的组成和控制进行修改，而不仅仅是孤立地编辑提示词。 Meta-Harness 通过利用历史代码、评估分数和执行轨迹来优化围绕固定模型的配套程序，从而拓展了这一方向（Lee et al., 2026）。 这种程序层面的视角促使我们选择可执行的配套程序作为改进对象，它既包括证据处理工具，也包括使用这些工具输出结果的逻辑。

paragraphs.en: Self-improvement also concerns which system proposes the changes. STOP studies an improvement program that modifies itself ( Zelikman et al., 2024 ) , and the Darwin Gödel Machine combines self-modification with exploration over an archive of agents ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Self-Harness uses the same frozen model to propose harness revisions and validates candidates through regression testing ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Video-RSI builds on this code-level self-improvement setting, with the same language model serving as Solver and Editor. Our focus is the evidence available to that Editor. An execution trace records only what the current harness observed, so investigating the original video can distinguish failure explanations that would otherwise motivate different revisions.
paragraphs.zh: 自我改进还涉及由哪个系统提出变更。 STOP 研究了一种能够自我修改的改进程序（Zelikman 等，2024），而达尔文·哥德尔机则将自我修改与对智能体档案库的探索相结合（Zhang 等，2026b）。 Self-Harness 使用相同的冻结模型来提出 harness 的修订方案，并通过回归测试验证候选方案（Zhang 等，2026a）。 Video-RSI 在这一代码级的自我改进设定基础上进行扩展，由同一语言模型同时充当求解器和编辑器。 我们的关注点在于该编辑器可获得哪些证据。 执行轨迹仅记录当前 harness 所观察到的内容，因此通过研究原始视频，可以区分那些原本可能导致不同修订方案的故障解释。

paragraphs.en: Video self-improvement has been explored through the generation and refinement of training signals. paragraphs.en: VideoHarness-RSI is a closely related approach to video harness evolution ( Xu and Chen, 2026 ) . It evolves context-construction programs that can coordinate retrieval, evidence representations, and auxiliary model calls around frozen vision–language models, and promotes candidates that improve validation accuracy. Video-RSI shares this program-level search setting and focuses on how the Editor obtains evidence for a revision. Active investigation of the original videos tests failure explanations before code is edited. Our selection rule also accounts for visual cost, admitting accuracy gains with bounded cost growth or cost reductions with bounded accuracy loss. Together, investigation and selection connect reusable harness changes to their effects on answer quality and observation requirements.
paragraphs.zh: VideoHarness-RSI 是一种与视频 harness 演化（Xu 和 Chen，2026）密切相关的方法。 它演化出能够围绕固定的视觉-语言模型协调检索、证据表示和辅助模型调用的上下文构建程序，并促进那些能提高验证准确性的候选方案。 Video-RSI 共享这种程序级的搜索设置，并关注编辑器如何为修订获取证据。 对原始视频进行主动调查，可以在代码编辑前检验失败的解释。 我们的选择规则也考虑了视觉成本，允许在成本增长有限时提升准确性，或在准确性损失有限时降低成本。 综合而言，调查与选择将可重用的 harness 变更与其对答案质量和观察要求的影响联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Video-RSI uses the same frozen language model as Solver and Editor, accumulating improvements in executable code ( Xu and Chen, 2026 ) . At each attempt, the Solver executes H t H_{t} on training questions. The Editor examines its traces and revisits videos to test failure explanations before proposing a candidate H ~ t \widetilde{H}_{t} . paragraphs.en: Relative to VideoSeek, the accuracy–cost balance varies across benchmarks. On MLVU, Video-RSI gains 4.8 percentage points while using 27.2% fewer frames, combining better answers with reduced visual usage. On LongVideoBench, the main benefit is substantially fewer frames at similar accuracy. On EgoSchema, both accuracy and frame usage improve. On Video-MME, higher accuracy accompanies a moderate increase in frame usage. Thus, the advantage is not a uniform reduction in observation, but a favorable balance between answer quality and visual usage across different evaluation settings.
paragraphs.zh: 与 VideoSeek 相比，不同基准测试中准确率与成本之间的平衡关系各不相同。 在 MLVU 上，Video-RSI 的准确率提升了 4.8 个百分点，同时使用的帧数减少了 27.2%，实现了更优的答案与更低视觉资源消耗的结合。 在 LongVideoBench 上，主要优势在于以相近的准确率大幅减少了所需帧数。 在 EgoSchema 上，准确率和帧使用量均得到提升。 在 Video-MME 上，准确率的提升伴随着帧使用量的适度增加。 因此，其优势并非观察资源的一概减少，而是在不同评估场景下实现了答案质量与视觉资源消耗之间的良好平衡。

paragraphs.en: Compared with VideoHarness-RSI, Video-RSI achieves higher accuracy with fewer frames on every benchmark. The accuracy gain is largest on Video-MME, whereas EgoSchema shows closely comparable accuracy with substantially lower frame usage. The evolved harness thus offers two practical benefits by improving answer quality and reducing the observations needed for comparable performance. The controlled comparisons in Section 4.3 further examine how active investigation and cost-aware selection contribute to the resulting harness.

paragraphs.en: Table 2 examines how harness evolution depends on the evidence available before revision and the criterion used to retain candidates. The trajectory-only variant restricts the Editor to existing execution traces, while active investigation allows additional video observations before editing. Both use 20 revision attempts under the shared conditions in Section 4.1 . The accuracy-only gate variant examines selection without the visual-cost criterion. We evaluate the resulting harnesses on all four benchmarks, using the initial harness as a reference.
paragraphs.zh: 表2研究了智能体框架的演化如何依赖于修订前可用的证据以及用于保留候选方案的标准。 仅轨迹变体将编辑器的权限限制在现有的执行轨迹内，而主动调查则允许在编辑前进行额外的视频观察。 在4.1节中设定的共同条件下，两种方法均使用20次修订尝试。 仅准确性门控变体研究了不采用视觉成本标准时的选择过程。 我们在全部四个基准测试上评估了由此生成的智能体框架，并以初始智能体框架作为参考。

paragraphs.en: Active investigation yields higher final accuracy than trajectory-only revision on every benchmark. On MLVU, the gain reaches 8.2 percentage points with similar inference-time frame usage. On the other three benchmarks, higher accuracy accompanies fewer frames. This pattern links additional evidence during offline revision to better deployed behavior without a consistent increase in inference-time observation. The investigation-enabled run also retains five of twenty revisions, compared with three for trajectory-only revision. Alongside the endpoint results, these observations support using evidence beyond the existing trace to guide reusable harness changes.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有基准测试中，主动调查都能比仅依赖轨迹的修订方法获得更高的最终准确率。 在 MLVU 上，这种提升达到了 8.2 个百分点，同时推理阶段的帧使用量也基本相同。 在其他三个基准测试中，更高的准确率伴随着更少的帧使用量。 这一模式表明，在离线修订阶段引入更多证据，能够改善部署后的行为表现，而无需持续增加推理阶段的观察量。 启用调查的运行方案还保留了二十次修订中的五次，而仅依赖轨迹的修订方案只保留了三次。 除了最终结果之外，这些观察结果还支持利用现有轨迹之外的证据来指导可重复使用的框架调整。

paragraphs.en: The accuracy-only gate improves accuracy over the initial harness on all four benchmarks, but increases frame usage on three. Video-RSI achieves higher accuracy than this variant while using fewer frames on every benchmark. On Video-MME, it uses roughly half as many frames. Thus, the cost-aware run obtains visual savings without sacrificing endpoint accuracy in these evaluations. The comparison shows why accuracy gains alone do not fully characterize a useful harness revision. Selecting for both objectives can retain more efficient behavior while preserving improvements in answer quality.
paragraphs.zh: 仅关注准确性的门控在所有四个基准测试中都比初始框架提高了准确性，但使三个基准测试的帧使用量增加。 Video-RSI 在每个基准测试中都比该变体实现了更高的准确性，同时使用的帧数更少。 在 Video-MME 上，它使用的帧数大约减少了一半。 因此，在这些评估中，考虑成本的运行方案在保持终端准确性的同时实现了视觉上的优化。 这一比较表明，仅凭准确性的提升并不能全面反映一个有用的框架修订版本。 同时选择这两个目标可以在保持答案质量改进的同时，保留更高效的行为。

paragraphs.en: Figure 3 tracks the retained harness over 20 revision attempts on the development set and MLVU. The MLVU evaluations were performed retrospectively after evolution and did not inform candidate selection. On the development set, the first accepted revision produces most of the net reduction in frame usage, while subsequent revisions steadily improve accuracy with smaller, nonmonotonic changes in visual cost. The run thus combines an early efficiency gain with continued refinement of answer quality.
paragraphs.zh: 图 3 追踪了开发集和 MLVU 上经过 20 次修订尝试后保留的约束条件。 MLVU 评估是在演化之后回顾性进行的，并未用于指导候选智能体的选择。 在开发集上，首次被接受的修订带来了框架使用量的大部分净减少，而后续修订则通过视觉成本较小且非单调的变化持续提升了准确性。 因此，此次运行结合了早期的效率提升与答案质量的持续优化。

paragraphs.en: The MLVU trajectory reveals that improvements on the selection set need not transfer at every step. The first accepted revision reduces frame usage but lowers MLVU accuracy, despite improving both development metrics. Accuracy recovers with the next revision, and the final two accepted revisions account for most of the net MLVU accuracy gain. The final harness therefore reflects cumulative refinement beyond the initial efficiency improvement. An early development gain alone would give an incomplete picture of its evaluation behavior.
paragraphs.zh: MLVU 轨迹表明，选择集上的改进并不一定在每一步都会迁移。 第一个被接受的修订减少了帧的使用，但降低了 MLVU 的准确性，尽管它同时改善了两个开发指标。 随着下一个修订的引入，准确性得以恢复，而最后两个被接受的修订贡献了大部分净 MLVU 准确性的提升。 因此，最终的整合方案体现了超越初始效率改进的累积性优化。 仅凭早期的开发阶段所获得的提升，无法完整反映其评估行为。

paragraphs.en: Accuracy and visual cost also follow different paths during later refinement. From H S ​ 2 H_{S2} onward, MLVU accuracy rises together with frame usage, yet the final harness remains more accurate and uses fewer frames than H S ​ 0 H_{S0} . This pattern is consistent with the selection rule, which permits bounded cost increases for accuracy gains, rather than requiring frame usage to decrease at every update. Later revisions can use more frames while retaining a net efficiency advantage over the initial harness, improving the final accuracy–cost balance.
paragraphs.zh: 在后续优化过程中，准确率和视觉成本也沿着不同的路径发展。 从 H S ​ 2 H_{S2} 开始，MLVU 的准确率随着帧使用量的增加而提升，但最终架构仍比 H S ​ 0 H_{S0} 更准确且使用的帧更少。 这一模式与选择规则一致：该规则允许为提升准确率而适度增加成本，而非要求每次更新都必须减少帧使用量。 后续修订版本可以使用更多帧，同时仍然保持相对于初始架构的净效率优势，从而改善最终的准确率–成本平衡。

paragraphs.en: Structured perception. In H S ​ 2 H_{S2} , free-form visual responses give way to goal-directed observations with structured findings, image references, and explicit uncertainty. The harness maps image references to frame timestamps, preserving the link between a finding and its temporal evidence. This interface lets follow-up reasoning target unresolved details and their supporting frames without changing model weights.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化感知。 在 H S ​ 2 H_{S2} 中，自由形式的视觉响应让位于以目标为导向的观察，这些观察包含结构化的发现、图像引用和明确的未知性。 该机制将图像引用映射到帧时间戳，从而保留发现与其时间证据之间的关联。 此接口使后续推理能够针对未解决的细节及其支持的帧进行定位，而无需更改模型权重。

paragraphs.en: We presented Video-RSI, a framework for improving video understanding agents through harness evolution with fixed model weights. The same language model serves as Solver and Editor, revisiting training videos to test failure explanations and translating the resulting diagnoses into reusable code changes. Cost-aware selection retains revisions according to both answer accuracy and visual usage. Across four benchmarks, the evolved harness improves accuracy while using fewer frames than its initial version, with ablations supporting the contributions of active investigation and cost-aware selection. Analysis of the retained code reveals changes in structured perception, evidence reuse, and selective observation. Together, these findings support harness evolution as a practical route to improving how frozen-model video agents acquire and use evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Video-RSI，一个通过利用固定模型权重的演化机制来提升视频理解智能体的框架。 同一语言模型同时充当求解器和编辑器，它会重新观看训练视频以检验失败原因的解释，并将由此得出的诊断结果转化为可复用的代码修改。 成本感知选择机制会根据答案准确率和视觉使用率两项标准来保留修订版本。 在四个基准测试中，经过演化的 harness 在提升准确率的同时，比初始版本使用的帧数更少，消融研究也验证了主动探索和成本感知选择的贡献。 对保留代码的分析显示，结构化感知、证据复用和选择性观察等方面都发生了变化。 综合来看，这些发现支持将 harness 演化视为提升固定模型视频智能体获取和使用证据能力的一种实用途径。
